pr_body:
This should fix #55415 for tiling window managers (what has sane defaults).

## Currently windows are created with `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_NORMAL` atom and it causes some jarring behavior with tiling window manager.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10142805/143886940-fd40f147-ccae-42c6-bd10-b3db77a1226e.png)

## After the change tiling window managers can read info about window type and set default to floating.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10142805/143886556-b7a62269-7d07-4328-bd29-9e8218310d61.png)

Most, if not all Tiling Window Managers will look into `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE` value to determine if it's floating window.

pr_comments: I can confirm on `bspwm` this works like a charm, good job! :tada:

This makes sense to me for actual dialogs/popups, but I'm not sure this is correct for secondary windows which are meant to be treated as normal windows (for example if you undock the Inspector dock, or the script editor, etc.). CC @bruvzg in case you have an idea on whether we have an API to differentiate those.
That's probably should be set only for transient windows. And set/unset in the `DisplayServerX11::window_set_transient`  instead of `_create_window`.
Took while, but moved that change to `DisplayServerX11::window_set_transient`
I force pushed an update to solve merge conflicts.

issue_context.title: X11 DisplayServer does not set correct `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE` for dialogs, causing issues with tiling window managers (DisplayServer regression)
comments:
See also #37930 and #38727

I remember experimenting with the `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_DIALOG` atom a long time ago without great results, but that was before that PR was merged, so it might work without issues now.

At least in testing I did yesterday, with that patch it seemed to work correctly in QTile. And as far I recall `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_DIALOG` is also default floating window in i3wm, if not but it can be easily enabled as floating window type in i3wm if not default.

review_comments: It probably should also revert it to `_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_NORMAL` when transient parent is unset?
